footnote_text: Represents the number of shares required to be sold by the Reporting Person to cover tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting of RSU's. Included in 100 restricted stock units awarded to the Reporting Person on April 26, 2024, pursuant to the Co-Diagnostics, Inc. 2015 Long Term Incentive Plan, and vest in 6 equal installments every 6 months commencing on November 23, 2024. Included in 113 restricted stock units awarded to the Reporting Person on August 13, 2025, pursuant to the Co-Diagnostics, Inc. 2015 Long Term Incentive Plan,and vest in 6 equal installments every 6 months commencing on November 23, 2025. Restricted stock units convert to common stock on a one-for-one basis.
